notes.title: 6/25 Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Hotfix - The damage an enemy shows they will do includes player expose and enemy buff amount. Meaning that there is no additional math needed to take into consideration when blocking an enemy. 

If the attack says 0 when playing defense cards, the attack will do 0 and not apply anything.

Also you can now play 0 attack cards on enemies when they have expose on them, to deal expose damage.

notes.title: Update 11 - The Great Tutorial Purge and Other Things
notes.content:
Heard all of you loud and clear that there is just too much reading simulator in a card game. So I removed a number of redundant tutorials, merged some, made some into graphics and just overall did my best to cut down on the tutorial reading. 

The 2 big ones are still the combat tutorial (shortened) and the forge tutorial. The rest have either been streamlined or removed entirely.

There is also a number of bug fixes around defense and buff, as well as other items that have come up over the past few days.

I appreciate all the input from everyone and I am working my fastest to resolve issues before EA release next week. Expect probably 1 or 2 more updates.

As always let me know if you see anything or have any issues. 

Thanks!
Luigi

notes.title: Update 10 - The Great Rebalance
notes.content:
Hello all!
Another update based off a number of items from the Steam Next Fest.

The biggest change is that I have rebalanced all the cards, stones and enemies. TLDR; I have a spreadsheet that I made that tells me things about the power ranges of things, and I have evened everything out. 

This does 2 things, it evens out the gameplay at the start of the game to be a bit more challenging and stops cards becoming super OP as quickly as they were. Secondly, it makes enemies feel more fair later on a bit more of a challenge at the start.

Thank you everyone and keep letting me know about issues, ideas and everything else!

[/list]

notes.title: Update 8 - New status effects and introduction of status triggers
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
Some big changes to expand the strategy side of the game. I have added a number of new effects which also has increased the card and stone pool to pull from.

With this change I have also added a new system called status triggers. Each card now has 1 effect that is considered the main effect. When a card is played, the main effect has the potential to trigger other effects based on various conditions.

Played a card with a burn main effect? Melt any ice on the target and cause blindness.
Played a card with a poison main effect? Add weakness status if the target is also bleeding.
Played a card with a heal main effect? Increase regen potency on yourself.
Played a card with a ice main effect? Turn water and bleed effect on target into additional ice.

I have also updated a number of systems, you can now fight a number of different enemies in once combat. Also enemies will either attack or defend and play appropriate actions around that.

As always let me know of any issues or feedback!

As always let me know of any issues or anything!

[+] Added a new quest to crystallize a card.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[+] Fixed an issue with Cursed Woods.
[+] Addressed a bug where using a defense card would block damage from all enemies.
[+] Corrected an issue where the last few hexes displayed incorrect pathing areas.
[+] Resolved a saving issue where the type of stones added to a card wasn't visible upon loading the game.
[+] Removed chicken from level 3 stratum.
[+] Fixed an issue where cards were lost when starting a new journey and then exiting the game while on the new journey screen.
[+] Fixed a problem where stones were not saved when saving/quitting a journey and then continuing it.
[+] Rectified an issue where changing the cost of a card disabled the buttons.
[+] Fixed an error with the bug report form not submitting consistently.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[B] Added fragment drops to stratum bosses.
[B] Increased fragment gains.
[B] Rare/ultra-rare cards and stones now drop more frequently in higher stratums and less often in lower-level stratums.
[B] Increased the drop rate of rare stones and cards in the shop.
[B] Added more stones to the shop.
[B] Lowered the cost of rerolling shops from 400 to 200.
[B] Slightly nerfed stones.
[B] Rebalanced basic cards.
[B] Removed the increase in energy cost when slotting stones in the forge.

[B] Lowered the player's base max health to 75.
[B] Increased enemy health for higher-level stratums and decreased it for lower-level stratums.
[B] Each enemy may now have different health amounts.
[B] Increased the amount of stones available in cities.
[B] Added 2 more cards to the card shop in journeys.
[B] Players now only start with common cards and common stones.
[B] Increased fragments gained from fragmenting cards and stones.

[h2]Design/UI[/h2]
[+] Conducted a major redesign of the fight screen.
[+] Added indication of the card multiplier currently active.
[+] Implemented visual indication of defense cards lessening attacks.
[+] Added animations to player health and effects that hit the player.

notes.title: Stratum Descent Update 5 - Saving Journeys and Curses
notes.content:
Smaller update with big changes. This update comes with 2 big changes.
1. The ability to save and continue a journey some other time. There is only 1 save slot.
2. Curses, trying out some curses that you can get via 2 new events, they hinder you for a few fights or the entire journey.

So not a lot of new content, but new ways to enjoy the current content at your own pace and also new content to make runs more interesting.

As always let me know your thoughts and keep submitting those bug reports!
